records.subject: CHE
records.title: Overview of Chemical Engineering
records.description: Current topics, issues, and career options in Chemical Engineering.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Introduction to Chemical Engineering
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHE 101 with a C or better; CHEM 105 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment in CHEM 106, 345, or 348; MATH 171 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment in MATH 172, 182, 273, or 315.
records.description: Introduction to chemical engineering; development of problem-solving skills.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Chemical Process Principles and Calculations
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHE 110 with a C or better, or BIO ENG 140 with an S, or junior standing; CHEM 106 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment in CHEM 345 or 348; MATH 172 or 182 with a C or better, or concurrent enrollment in MATH 273 or 315.
records.description: Fundamental concepts of chemical engineering; problem-solving techniques and applications in stoichiometry, material and energy balances, and phase equilibria.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Process Simulation
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHE 201 with a C or better; MATH 315 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Computer solutions to problems in chemical engineering processing.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHE 101, CHE 211, and CHEM 345 each with a C or better or concurrent enrollment; PHYSICS 202 and 212 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Chemical Engineering.
records.description: Basic concepts in chemical engineering thermodynamics; First and Second Laws; property relationships; power, compression, and liquefaction.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics II
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHE 301 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Chemical Engineering.
records.description: Intermediate topics in chemical engineering thermodynamics; advanced phase and chemical reaction equilibrium (including the design of relevant chemical processes), non-ideal thermodynamics, and a microscopic description of thermodynamics.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Introduction to Transport Processes
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite:  CHE 201 with a C or better; MATH 315 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment; BIO ENG 205 or both CHE 101 and CHE 211 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment; admitted to the major in CHE or BIO ENG.
records.description: Fundamentals of the phenomena governing the transport of momentum, energy, and mass.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Kinetics and Reactor Design
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHE 211 and 310 with a C or better; CHE 302 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment; admitted to the major in Chemical Engineering.
records.description: Chemical reaction kinetics applied to the design of reactors, non-ideal flow, mixing, catalysis.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Fluid Mechanics and Heat Transfer
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHE 302 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment; CHE 211 and 310 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Chemical Engineering.
records.description: Design calculations, operations, and evaluation of equipment used in fluid flow, heat transfer, and evaporation.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Chemical Engineering Separations
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHE 302 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment; CHE 211 and 310  with a C or better; CHEM 345 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Chemical Engineering.
records.description: Design and evaluation of equipment used in continuous contacting.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Chemical Process Safety
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHE 321 with a C or better; CHE 332 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Chemical Engineering.
records.description: Introduction to technical fundamentals of chemical process safety.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Catalysis: From Fundamentals to Industrial Applications
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHE 302 and 321 with a C or better.
records.description: An introduction to modern catalysis systems for chemical engineers, with an emphasis on heterogeneous catalysis.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Mixed AND/OR scope needs review

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Chemical Engineering Lab I
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHE 302, 321, 332 and 334 with a C or better; CHE 352 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment; ENGLISH 402 or 403 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment; admitted to the major in Chemical Engr.
records.description: Statistical design and analysis of experiments; safety; experiments in heat and mass transfer; separations, other unit operations, kinetics, control; technical reports and presentations.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Chemical Engineering Lab II
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHE 432 with a C or better.
records.description: Laboratory experiments in heat and mass transfer; separations, other unit operations, kinetics, control; design calculations; technical reports and presentations.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Process Control
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite:  CHE 302, 321, 332, and 334 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Chemical Engineering.
records.description: Measuring instruments, automatic control, process and instrument characteristics and theory applied to industrial control problems.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Chemical Process Analysis and Design I
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHE 302, 321, 332, and 334 with a C or better; CHE 352 with a C or better or concurrent; ENGLISH 402 or 403 with a C or better or concurrent; admitted to the major in Chemical Engineering.
records.description: Chemical engineering design; computer tools; safety and environmental constraints; cost and equipment optimization.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Chemical Process Analysis and Design II
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHE 450 with a C or better; junior standing.
records.description: Development, design, and economic evaluation of chemical and related processes as practiced in industry.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Introduction to Nuclear Engineering
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 315; admitted to a major in engineering or physical sciences; senior standing.
records.description: Applied nuclear physics; application to the nuclear fuel cycle and nuclear reactor core design; nuclear reactor systems and safety. (Crosslisted course offered as ME 461, CHE 461.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Applied Electrochemistry
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHE 302 and 321 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Chemical Engineering.
records.description: Thermodynamics, kinetics, and transport processes that occur in a simple model electrochemical system and how to apply them into more complicated real systems.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Introduction to Upstream/Midstream Technology
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHE 301 with a C or better.
records.description: An introduction for chemical engineers to oil and gas exploration, production, transportation, and storage.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Unparsed source wording: CoursePrerequisite:withaCbetter

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Integrated Envirochemical Engineering
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHE 321 with a C or better; CHE 334 with a C or better.
records.description: Application of chemical engineering principles in assessment and remediation of industrial problems in air pollution, water pollution, and solid and hazardous waste.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Unparsed source wording: CoursePrerequisite:withaCbetter

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Biofilm Engineering
records.description: Medical and environmental biofilms; biofilm processes and biofilm control.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Metabolic Engineering
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHE 201 with a C or better; MATH 220 and MATH 315 with a C or better; BIO ENG 210 or CHE 211 with a C or better.
records.description: Understanding metabolic properties of organisms such that cells can be modified for use as biochemical plants to produce desired bioproducts. (Crosslisted course offered as BIO ENG 455, CHE 474.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Unparsed source wording: CoursePrerequisite:withaCbetter

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Biochemical Engineering
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHE 321 and 332 each with a C or better, OR BIO ENG 310 and 350 each with a C or better.
records.description: Application of chemical engineering principles to the processing of biological and biochemical materials.  (Crosslisted course offered as CHE 475, BIO ENG 475.)  Credit not granted for both CHE 475/BIO ENG 475 and CHE 575.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Mixed AND/OR scope needs review

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Applied Molecular and Cellular Bioengineering
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: BIO ENG 350, OR CHE 310 and CHE 301, each with a C or better.
records.description: Applying bioengineering and chemical engineering kinetics and transport principles to practical applications in cellular and biological separations, biomanufacturing, tissue engineering, protein design, drug delivery, and bioassays. (Crosslisted course offered as CHE 476, BIO ENG 476.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Mixed AND/OR scope needs review

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Pulp and Paper Manufacturing Process Engineering
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHE 110 or 201, with a C or better; junior standing.
records.description: Study of pulping and papermaking process chemistry and reaction engineering principles.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Special Topics in Chemical Engineering
records.description: Pulp and paper processing, advanced separations, and atomistic methods in chemical engineering.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Interfacial Phenomena
records.description: Chemical and physical nature of the interface including the molecular basis for interfacial forces and resulting macroscopic phenomena. Credit not granted for both CHE 485 and 585.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Professional Practice Coop/Internship I
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: By department permission.
records.description: Practicum for students admitted to the VCEA Professional Practice and Experiential Learning Program; integration of coursework with on-the-job professional experience. (Crosslisted course offered as ENGR 488, BIO ENG 488, CHE 488, CE 488, CPT S 488, E E 488, ME 488, MSE 488, SDC 488.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHE
records.title: Chemical Engineering Internship
records.description: Students work full time in engineering assignments in approved industries with prior approval of advisor and industrial supervisor.

records.title: Technical Seminar
